notes.title: V1.10 Controller Support
notes.notes: [p]Updates: [/p][list][*][p]Controller Support Added[/p][list][*][p]Full support for Xbox, PlayStation, and Steam Deck controllers. Navigate menus and play seamlessly with your gamepad of choice.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gameplay Improvements[/p][list][*][p]DNA Can Now Be Removed Anytime[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Scoring System Display[/p][list][*][p]Score = Total Turns - Number of 21s Achieved[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Audio Sliders Fixed After Game Restart[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix: Fullscreen bug
notes.notes: Game would start in fullscreen at the wrong resolution, Overdrawn will now default to Maximized Window until the issue is fixed.

notes.title: Post Launch Update #3
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]

Added volume controls for [b]Sound FX[/b] and [b]Music[/b]

Added a [b]Fullscreen toggle[/b] option in the settings menu

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed a bug with the [b]Mirror One[/b] card not functioning correctly

[b]DNA[/b] descriptions now only display if you have more than one DNA active

Fixed an issue where returning to the [b]Main Menu during Character Select[/b] and then resuming the game would cause the character screen to appear blank

notes.title: Post Launch Update #2
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Leaderboard position text now displays correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Diablo now correctly adds Burn cards only on odd turns, as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Menu Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Returning to the main menu no longer restarts the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to [b]continue your run[/b] from the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Option to [b]restart the game[/b] is now included in the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Card Draw Adjustment:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now draw cards as long as there's room in your hand.[/p][/*][*][p]"Hand size" now refers to your [b]starting hand size[/b], not the maximum limit.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Post Launch Update #1
notes.notes: Fixing bug on leaderboards where it was only displaying one entry.
